college_info: Institute of Aeronautical Engineering (IARE), Hyderabad, is a premier autonomous institution approved by AICTE and affiliated to JNTUH, offering cutting-edge engineering programs with strong focus on research, placements, and innovation.
admissions: IARE admissions are done via TS EAMCET, ECET, and GATE/PGECET counseling or through management quota. Visit the admissions block or iare.ac.in for details.
placements: IARE has an active Career Guidance and Placement Cell. Top recruiters include Amazon, Microsoft, Infosys, Wipro, and Cognizant with strong average packages.
exams: End-semester examination schedules, mid-term timetables, and hall tickets are officially updated on the IARE student portal and LMS.
hostels: Separate hostel facilities are available for boys and girls with 24/7 security, Wi-Fi, and mess facilities near the campus.
events: Annual technical and cultural fests like 'Synapse' and various hackathons are hosted regularly at the main auditorium.
